notes.title: GunBlocks Update - Drone Race
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39359669/a326b0a7fa1a1fef242a995f19217db0f88eadcd.png

Dear fellows!

After a period of silence we can proudly present you the first major content update for the GunBlocks Prologue! In this side quest you challenge the drones in a wild race without any rules. You might need practice to master all three difficulties, but don't give up!

You can access the drone race on the first island once the main quest is finished. As this is still a beta version, we're (again) very grateful for any feedback. Use the in-game reporting tool or our Discord server.
Go go go!

https://i.imgur.com/kBzWUNg.gif

Also our newsletter is online, subscribe today and stay updated for ever :D

Enjoy the race and let me know how fun it was!
- Steve
